_about: Inputs and parameters for 4.5 multitemporal lidar at plugged wells. VERIFY marks an assumed input or a proposed default. Edit freely.
flight_metadata_schema: project, tile (blank = whole project), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), end_date, source (USGS project report, XML metadata URL, page). D1. VERIFY by reading the USGS project metadata.
dems_note: v2 rebuild from notebooks/wellsight_v2/s7_analysis/_change_rebuild_v2_9t.py, the field behind change_features_summary_v2_9t.json. Git-ignored, regenerate with that script.
restoration_schema: permit_num, restoration_date, earthwork (true|false|unknown), source. R7. Optional. Separates plugging from dated surface restoration.

eligibility.min_eligible_note: User decision for the preregistration (power). Proposed default.

controls.covariates_note: seam_dist_m added 2026-11-06 (review 4.5-02). Distance from the pad to the nearest straight survey seam in dod_v2_highpass_9t_2m.tif.
controls.seam_band_note: Exact-match strata on seam distance (near under 50 m, far beyond). 2026-11-06 user accepted default 50 m ("take defaults"). Change freely.

flag_rule.source: notebooks/wellsight_v2/s7_analysis/_change_features_9t.py (THR, MIN_COVER, P_CUT, N_CTRL, SLOPE_TOL imported at run time)

recovery.register_note: Unused since 2026-11-06. S3 now runs the S4 point chain (per-pass shift and overlap offsets), not a DEM shift.
recovery.reproduce_note: RMS tolerance for the h = 0 chain against the held dod_v2_highpass_9t_2m.tif. 2026-11-06 user accepted default 0.01 m ("take defaults"). Change freely.

compare.delta_rate_note: User decision. The useful flag-rate difference from the decision the flag changes. Proposed default. Not from variance.
